game.name: Freaks 2.x
game.desc: A 3D maze and monster smashing adventure, remade from the 90s MS-DOS game Freaks! with full-angle rotation, depth cue lighting, rain and lightning storms. Your health doesn't come back on its own: you heal by feeding on the corpses of the monsters you kill.
game.developer: Angel Ortega, Manuel Zamora, Antonio Guerrero
